description: Reusable, source-backed audit criteria for scoring media-buyer decisions. Each criterion is a single checkable rule drawn from an authoritative PPC/paid-social source. Attach criteria to a case by id (see rubrics/README.md). Thresholds are DEFAULTS and are tunable per case; do not treat them as laws.

type_legend.programmatic: Objective check computable from account/case data (no LLM needed).
type_legend.judge: Subjective call that requires an LLM-judge or human rubric.

authority_legend.official: Published by the ad platform itself (Google/Meta/X docs).
authority_legend.expert: Published by a recognized practitioner/tool (Adalysis, Optmyzr, Brad Geddes, WordStream, named PPC authorities).
authority_legend.convention: Widely used industry number with no authoritative published cutoff. Treat as tunable and lower-confidence.

principles: Score decision quality given the data, not realized outcomes. There is no outcome ground truth in paid media.
Never use an aggregate score (Google Optimization Score, WordStream grade) as ground truth: both reward suggestion-adoption, not ROI. Use the individual underlying checks instead.
Senior judgment beats checkbox-following. Some 'best practice' checks have evidence-backed exceptions (e.g. Ad Strength); these are tagged with a caution.
Thresholds are defaults. Prefer band-based scoring over hard pass/fail on borderline metrics.

criteria.title: Ad group has no active ads
criteria.condition: Ad group with 0 enabled ads.

criteria.title: Ad group running a single ad (no test in flight)
criteria.condition: Ad group with exactly 1 enabled ad, so no A/B test is possible.

criteria.title: Too many ads per ad group (test dilution)
criteria.condition: Ad group with more than the recommended number of enabled ads, slowing time-to-significance.
criteria.notes: Adalysis recommends max 3; for high-volume groups 2-4 is acceptable.

criteria.title: Too many keywords per ad group (loose theming)
criteria.condition: Ad group with more keywords than its theme can support, hurting ad relevance.
criteria.notes: Threshold varies by source: Adalysis flags >50; WordStream ~20; SEJ recommends <=10. Set per case.

criteria.title: Ad group has no responsive search ad
criteria.condition: Ad group with 0 RSAs. Google requires at least 1 RSA per ad group (best practice: 2 at Good/Excellent strength).

source.name: Google Ads Help — Responsive search ads

criteria.title: Search campaign opted into Display network
criteria.condition: Search campaign with 'Search with Display Select' enabled, mixing two channels under one budget/strategy.

criteria.title: Auto-apply recommendations enabled (risk)
criteria.condition: Account has auto-apply recommendations turned on, allowing unreviewed structural changes.

criteria.title: Keep themed ad groups to 5-15 keywords
criteria.condition: Tightly themed ad groups (5-15 closely related keywords) improve ad relevance; flag groups far outside this band for review.
criteria.judge_guidance: Counting is programmatic; whether the keywords are genuinely thematically coherent is a judged call.

criteria.title: Keyword spending with no conversions
criteria.condition: Keyword with 0 conversions and significant click volume over the window.

criteria.title: Keyword generating expensive conversions
criteria.condition: Keyword whose CPA is far above the ad group average.

criteria.title: Duplicate keywords within a campaign
criteria.condition: Same keyword/match-type appears more than once in a campaign, causing self-competition.

criteria.title: Keyword blocked by a negative keyword
criteria.condition: An active keyword is suppressed by a conflicting negative keyword.

criteria.title: Long-tail keyword usage
criteria.condition: Share of keywords that are long-tail (>=3 tokens), which tend to be higher-intent and cheaper.

criteria.title: Search terms reviewed weekly (esp. broad match)
criteria.condition: Search-term report should be reviewed at least weekly; flag accounts with no recent search-term review.

source.name: Search Engine Land — PPC management checklist

criteria.title: Irrelevant search terms consuming spend
criteria.condition: Search terms with spend that are irrelevant to the business and should be negated.
criteria.judge_guidance: Spend/zero-conversion trigger is programmatic; whether a term is actually irrelevant to this business is the judged call.

criteria.title: Campaign limited by budget
criteria.condition: Campaign shows 'Limited by budget' status or Search Lost IS (budget) > 0.

source.name: Google Ads Help — Limited by budget

criteria.title: Smart Bidding target too low (starving delivery)
criteria.condition: Google surfaces RAISE_TARGET_CPA_BID_TOO_LOW: the tCPA target is suppressing eligible volume.

criteria.title: Insufficient conversions for Target CPA
criteria.condition: Target CPA evaluated/used on a campaign with fewer than the recommended conversions in the trailing 30 days.

criteria.title: Insufficient conversions for Target ROAS
criteria.condition: Target ROAS on Search/Shopping with fewer than the recommended conversions (with values) in trailing 30 days.
criteria.notes: Video Action tROAS wants >=30; Demand Gen has separate thresholds.

criteria.title: Bidding strategy fits the stated goal
criteria.condition: The chosen bid strategy should match the business KPI (e.g. tROAS requires conversion values; lead-gen rarely wants Max Clicks).
criteria.judge_guidance: Assess whether the strategy is appropriate given the goal, conversion setup, and data volume.

criteria.title: Low Quality Score on high-spend keywords
criteria.condition: Keywords with low QS that also carry meaningful spend; prioritize by impression-weighted QS x cost.
criteria.notes: Google publishes no official QS floor. 'QS <= 5 = poor' and 'aim >= 7 non-brand' are Adalysis/industry conventions.

criteria.title: Quality Score component rated 'Below average'
criteria.condition: Any of Expected CTR / Ad Relevance / Landing Page Experience is 'Below average'.

criteria.title: High-volume keyword with a Quality Score drop
criteria.condition: Keyword with >=100 impressions in 7 days showing a negative QS trend.

criteria.title: RSA Ad Strength Poor/Average
criteria.condition: RSA rated Poor or Average. Google recommends Good/Excellent.
criteria.caution: DO NOT auto-penalize: an Optmyzr study of 1M+ ads found 'Average' RSAs had the BEST CPA/ROAS. A senior buyer may rightly ignore Ad Strength. Treat low Ad Strength as a prompt to inspect, not a defect.
criteria.judge_guidance: Reward responses that recognize Ad Strength is not a performance guarantee; penalize blindly chasing 'Excellent'.

criteria.title: RSA with all assets pinned
criteria.condition: RSA where every headline/description is pinned, removing the system's ability to optimize combinations.
criteria.notes: Optmyzr: 'some pinning' performed best; full pinning hurt conversion-based metrics.

criteria.title: RSA has too few assets
criteria.condition: RSA with fewer than the recommended headlines/descriptions (hard min 3 headlines / 2 descriptions; best practice 8-10 / 2-4).

source.name: Google Ads Help — RSA best practices

criteria.title: RSA asset exceeds character limits
criteria.condition: Headline > 30 chars, description > 90 chars, or display path segment > 15 chars.

source.name: Google Ads Help — Responsive search ads

criteria.title: Performance Max asset group below minimums
criteria.condition: PMax asset group missing required asset counts (>=3 headlines, >=1 long headline, >=2 descriptions, >=1 each of landscape/square image + logo).

source.name: Google Ads Help — PMax asset requirements

criteria.title: Declare ad-test winner only at sufficient confidence
criteria.condition: An ad/variant is paused as a 'loser' only when statistical confidence is high enough.
criteria.notes: Geddes/Adalysis deliberately avoid a fixed click count; significance is the gate, not raw sample size.

criteria.title: Ad rotation set to 'Rotate indefinitely' during a test
criteria.condition: Valid ad testing requires rotation = 'Rotate indefinitely' rather than Google's optimize/auto-rotation.

criteria.title: Ad test runs at least one full business cycle
criteria.condition: Do not judge a test before >=1 week of data spanning a full business cycle.

criteria.title: Ad with a falling CTR
criteria.condition: Ad whose CTR dropped >30% in the last 7 days vs last 30 days, with average position stable.

source.name: Adalysis — ads with a falling CTR

criteria.title: Disapproved or partially-approved ads/assets
criteria.condition: Ads or assets with disapproved/limited approval status.

criteria.title: Non-secure (http) final/mobile URLs
criteria.condition: Final or mobile URL uses http rather than https.

criteria.title: Ad copy relevance / message match
criteria.condition: Ad copy should reflect the keyword intent and the landing page offer.
criteria.judge_guidance: Assess keyword->ad->landing page message coherence and copy quality.

criteria.title: Conversion tracking present before spend
criteria.condition: Account/campaign has at least one active primary conversion action. Never spend without tracking.

criteria.title: No duplicate/double-counted primary conversions
criteria.condition: The same action is not counted by multiple 'Primary' conversion actions (e.g. native + GA4 import), which inflates conversions and misguides bidding.

criteria.title: Conversion counting matches business model
criteria.condition: Use 'Every' for ecommerce and 'One' for lead gen to avoid inflating lead counts.
criteria.judge_guidance: The counting setting is a data field; whether it matches the business model needs context.

criteria.title: Conversion value not left at placeholder
criteria.condition: Revenue-bearing conversions should carry real values, not the default '1' placeholder.

criteria.title: Call-conversion window too short
criteria.condition: Call conversions counted at Google's 60s default; recommend >=120s (ideally 300s) to count a real call.

criteria.title: Conversion windows within sane ranges
criteria.condition: Click-through window 1-90 days (default 30); view-through default 1 day.

criteria.title: Auto-tagging enabled
criteria.condition: Auto-tagging should be ON for accurate attribution and Analytics import.

criteria.title: Incomplete Google tag coverage
criteria.condition: Google surfaces IMPROVE_GOOGLE_TAG_COVERAGE: tagging is missing on parts of the site.

criteria.title: Location targeting set to 'Presence' not 'Presence or interest'
criteria.condition: The default 'Presence or interest' location setting is a top hidden source of wasted spend; recommend 'Presence (people in or regularly in)'.

criteria.title: Search Partners CPA far above Search
criteria.condition: Search Partners segment has materially higher CPA than core Search.

criteria.title: Automatic audience expansion disabled where appropriate
criteria.condition: Default audience expansion can dilute targeting; flag when left on for tightly-targeted campaigns.

criteria.title: Efficient keyword with room to grow impression share
criteria.condition: Keyword with impression share < 70% AND CPA <= half the ad-group average — a profitable scaling opportunity.

criteria.title: High Search Lost IS (budget)
criteria.condition: Campaign losing impression share to budget; the official signal is Lost IS (budget) > 0, with a tunable severity threshold.
criteria.notes: The metric is official; the 10% severity cutoff is a convention.

criteria.title: High Search Lost IS (rank)
criteria.condition: Campaign losing impression share to Ad Rank (a QS/bid problem, not budget).
criteria.notes: Metric official; severity cutoff is a convention.

criteria.title: Search campaign using no negative keywords
criteria.condition: Search campaign with zero negative keywords.

criteria.title: Negative keyword blocking valuable traffic
criteria.condition: A negative keyword conflicts with a converting search term / active keyword.

criteria.title: Ad set not exiting learning (under 50 conversions/7d)
criteria.condition: Ad set with fewer than ~50 optimization events in a rolling 7-day window, or status 'Learning Limited'.

criteria.title: Weekly budget too low to exit learning
criteria.condition: Weekly budget below ~50x the target cost-per-result, so 50 events/7d is unreachable.

criteria.title: Significant edit reset the learning phase
criteria.condition: A targeting / optimization-event / creative / bid change, or budget change >~20%, was made, resetting learning.

criteria.title: Creative fatigue from high frequency
criteria.condition: 7-day frequency above the fatigue threshold (cold ~3.0; retargeting ~5.0).
criteria.notes: Meta surfaces a creative-fatigue recommendation but publishes no fixed numeric cutoff; these are industry consensus.

criteria.title: Audience overlap between ad sets
criteria.condition: Overlap between ad-set audiences causing self-competition (15-30% friction; >30% danger).

criteria.title: Ads per ad set outside recommended range
criteria.condition: Non-Advantage+ ad set with fewer than 3 or more than ~6 active ads.

criteria.title: CBO campaign ad-set count outside 3-5
criteria.condition: Campaign Budget Optimization works best with 3-5 ad sets with non-overlapping audiences.

criteria.title: Lookalike source audience too small
criteria.condition: Lookalike source below 100 (cannot build) or below ~1,000 (low quality).

criteria.title: Creative text exceeds recommended limits
criteria.condition: Primary text > 125, headline > 40, or description > 30 characters (single-image feed).

criteria.title: Too little data to judge an ad set
criteria.condition: Drawing conclusions before ~50 conversions / the first 7 days have accrued.

criteria.title: Line items per campaign over API cap
criteria.condition: Campaign with more than 100 line items (hard X Ads API cap).

criteria.title: Keywords per line item over API cap
criteria.condition: Line item with more than 1,000 keywords (hard X Ads API cap).

criteria.title: Custom audience below usable minimum
criteria.condition: Custom/tailored audience below 100 matched users (unusable) or below 500 (not shown in the X Ads UI).

criteria.title: Target-bid line item outside the 20% cost band
criteria.condition: Line item using TARGET bidding whose actual average cost exceeds the target by more than 20%.

criteria.title: Accelerated delivery on an always-on campaign
criteria.condition: Evergreen/always-on campaigns should use standard delivery, not accelerated.
criteria.judge_guidance: The delivery flag is programmatic; whether the campaign is time-sensitive (where accelerated is fine) needs context.

criteria.title: Creatives per ad group outside 3-10
criteria.condition: Ad group with fewer than 3 or more than 10 creatives in rotation.

criteria.title: Platform-reported CPA reconciled against downstream truth
criteria.condition: Decisions should compare platform-reported CPA/ROAS against CRM/revenue truth, not trust each platform's self-reported number.
criteria.judge_guidance: Reward recognizing self-reported platform CPA can lie (overlapping attribution, view-through credit, micro-conversions); penalize moving budget on platform CPA alone.

criteria.title: Attribution windows differ across platforms
criteria.condition: Comparing platforms with different attribution windows (e.g. Meta 7-day click + 1-day view vs Google 30-day click) without normalizing.
criteria.judge_guidance: Detecting the mismatch can be programmatic if windows are in the data; judging whether the comparison was handled correctly is a judged call.

criteria.title: Do not treat optimization/grader score as ROI truth
criteria.condition: Aggregate scores (Google Optimization Score, WordStream grade) reward suggestion-adoption, not profit. They are not ground truth for good media buying.
criteria.judge_guidance: Penalize responses that chase optimization score for its own sake; reward using the underlying individual checks against business goals.

criteria.title: Preserve converting queries/segments when cutting waste
criteria.condition: When removing waste, do not pause/negate queries, keywords, or segments that are converting profitably.
criteria.judge_guidance: The set of converters is programmatic from the data; whether the response protects them (vs blanket-pausing) is the judged call.

source.name: Optmyzr / PPC audit best practice (cut waste, keep winners)

criteria.title: Judge performance by CPA/CVR with denominators, not vanity metrics
criteria.condition: Diagnose with conversion-rate / CPA using proper denominators rather than reacting to CTR or raw clicks alone.
criteria.judge_guidance: Reward responses that reason from CPA/CVR (conversions over clicks/spend); penalize treating a rising CTR as success while CPA worsens.

criteria.title: Do not raise budget before fixing the diagnosed cause
criteria.condition: Do not recommend raising/scaling budget as the primary fix when the real problem is waste, tracking, or relevance.
criteria.judge_guidance: Penalize reflexive 'increase budget' recommendations that ignore the diagnosed bottleneck.

source.name: PPC audit best practice (fix cause before scaling spend)

criteria.title: Judge incremental/segment economics, not brand-inflated or blended aggregates
criteria.condition: Do not act on a blended/aggregate metric (blended ROAS, account CPA, PMax including brand) that hides segment-level economics; separate brand vs non-brand and new vs returning before deciding to scale.
criteria.judge_guidance: Reward separating brand/returning (inflated) from non-brand/new-customer (incremental) economics; penalize scaling decisions justified by a blended number.

source.name: PPC measurement best practice (incrementality vs blended ROAS)
